_about: NumPlay fan games that use their original game's pictures, levels or names. Listed in the 'Fan games' category, downloaded from NumPlay's release like the others. Their icons are our own (tools/make_fan_icons.py), never the original game's art.

games.name: Among Us
games.description: Do your tasks on the Skeld and find the impostor among the bots.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures. Not affiliated with Innersloth.

games.name: Angry Birds
games.description: Sling birds at the pigs' forts: the Chrome edition's 429 levels, on Box2D physics.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures. Box2D by Erin Catto (zlib). Not affiliated with Rovio.

games.name: Bad Time Simulator
games.description: Survive Sans's fight: jcw87's 24 attack scripts.
games.credit: After jcw87's Bad Time Simulator, with Undertale's sprites. Not affiliated with jcw87 or Toby Fox.

games.name: Balatro
games.description: Poker hands, jokers and big multipliers in a roguelike deck builder.
games.credit: Fan game with art adapted from the original; m6x11 font by Daniel Linssen. Not affiliated with LocalThunk.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac
games.description: Cry your way through the basement's rooms, items and bosses.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures. Not affiliated with Edmund McMillen, Florian Himsl or Nicalis.

games.name: Buckshot Roulette
games.description: A shotgun, live and blank shells, items, and the dealer across the table.
games.credit: Fan game with scenes rendered from the original. Not affiliated with Mike Klubnika.

games.name: Cat Ninja
games.description: The Flash platformer's 30 levels: dodge lasers, grab the keys.
games.credit: Fan port of the original's code and pictures. Not affiliated with Richman Stewart or TrackMill.

games.name: Celeste
games.description: Climb the mountain: jump, dash and climb through tight platforming rooms.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures, maps and texts. Not affiliated with Maddy Makes Games.

games.name: Champion Island
games.description: The 2021 Doodle Champion Island Games: explore the island and win its sports.
games.credit: Fan game with the doodle's pictures, maps and texts; PixelMplus font. Not affiliated with Google.

games.name: Clash Royale
games.description: The 2016 cards, towers and rules against a bot.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's arenas, troops and card art. Not affiliated with Supercell.

games.name: Cookie Clicker
games.description: Bake cookies, buy grandmas, never stop clicking. Version 2.058.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures and texts. Not affiliated with Orteil or DashNet.

games.name: Crossy Road
games.description: Hop across roads, rivers and rails without getting squashed.
games.credit: Fan game with characters built from the original's models. Not affiliated with Hipster Whale.

games.name: Deltarune
games.description: Chapter 1: the Dark World, its battles and its texts.
games.credit: Fan game with Chapter 1's pictures, rooms and texts. Not affiliated with Toby Fox.

games.name: Donkey Kong
games.description: Climb the girders, jump the barrels, save Pauline. Arcade rules, new pictures.
games.credit: Fan game after the arcade program, with new pictures. Not affiliated with Nintendo.

games.name: Dune
games.description: Ride the dunes, fly off their tops, land smooth.
games.credit: Port of Inlogic's Dune Rider, inspired by Team Lava's Dune!; p2.js (MIT). Not affiliated with them.

games.name: The Final Earth 2
games.description: Build a city on a new planet in this pixel-art city builder.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures; sprites by LukXD99. Not affiliated with Florian van Strien.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's
games.description: Survive five nights in the security office.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures. Not affiliated with Scott Cawthon.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
games.description: No doors this time: a mask, a flashlight and a music box.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures. Not affiliated with Scott Cawthon.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 3
games.description: Thirty years later, one animatronic and failing systems.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures. Not affiliated with Scott Cawthon.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's 4
games.description: A bedroom, two doors, a closet and a flashlight.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures. Not affiliated with Scott Cawthon.

games.name: FNaF World
games.description: The FNaF characters in a turn-based adventure.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures. Not affiliated with Scott Cawthon.

games.name: Flappy Bird
games.description: Tap to flap between the pipes.
games.credit: Fan game, written in C. Not affiliated with Dong Nguyen.

games.name: Friday Night Funkin'
games.description: Rap battles: hit the arrows to the beat.
games.credit: Fan game after the game's open source code (Apache-2.0). Not affiliated with the Funkin' Crew.

games.name: Hill Climb Racing
games.description: Drive up hills without flipping or running out of fuel, on Box2D.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures; Box2D (zlib). Not affiliated with Fingersoft.

games.name: Hollow Knight
games.description: Explore Hallownest with nail and spells.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures, maps and texts. Not affiliated with Team Cherry.

games.name: Jetpack Joyride
games.description: Fly through the lab dodging zappers and missiles.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures. Not affiliated with Halfbrick.

games.name: Kingdom Rush
games.description: Tower defense: build towers, stop the waves, with heroes.
games.credit: Fan game from the original's Flash files. Not affiliated with Ironhide or Armor Games.

games.name: Level Devil
games.description: 80 rooms where the floor, spikes and doors trick you.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's rooms and sprites. Not affiliated with Unept.

games.name: Monkey Mart
games.description: Run a supermarket full of monkeys: grow, stock, sell.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures. Not affiliated with TinyDobbins.

games.name: Moto X3M
games.description: 50 stunt bike levels with flips and traps, on Nape physics.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures; Nape (BSD). Not affiliated with Madpuffers.

games.name: Mr Bullet
games.description: Spy puzzles: one shot, ricochets, grenades and hostages.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures; Box2D (zlib). Not affiliated with Lion Studios.

games.name: NumBlocks
games.description: Minecraft 1.8.8 on the calculator: mine, craft and build in 3D.
games.credit: Fan game with Minecraft's blocks, textures and screens. Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

games.name: NumDash
games.description: Geometry Dash: twelve of the real levels, from Stereo Madness to Clubstep.
games.credit: Fan game with Geometry Dash's levels. Not affiliated with RobTop Games.

games.name: Pac-Man
games.description: Eat the dots, dodge the ghosts.
games.credit: Fan game, written in C. Not affiliated with Bandai Namco.

games.name: Plants vs. Zombies
games.description: Plant your lawn's defenses against waves of zombies.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures. Not affiliated with PopCap or EA.

games.name: PolyTrack
games.description: Low-poly racing on the game's 17 tracks, in 3D.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's tracks and models; 3D engine from Boris-TH's PolyGT 3D. Not affiliated with Kodub.

games.name: Portal Returns
games.description: Portal puzzles in 2D, ported from the TI-84 Plus CE.
games.credit: By MateoConLechuga, sprites by CKH4. Not affiliated with Valve.

games.name: Rider
games.description: Flip a neon bike along the game's own tracks.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's levels; LiquidFun (zlib). Not affiliated with Ketchapp.

games.name: Snow Rider 3D
games.description: Sled down the slope dodging trees and snowmen, in 3D.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's models; brought to NumPlay by dennisimoo.

games.name: Sonic the Hedgehog
games.description: Run, roll and loop through the Mega Drive game's zones.
games.credit: Fan game from the Sonic Retro disassembly. Not affiliated with SEGA.

games.name: Space Invaders
games.description: Shoot down the descending invaders before they land.
games.credit: Fan game after the arcade, pictures redrawn. Not affiliated with Taito.

games.name: Stickman Hook
games.description: Swing from hook to hook to the finish.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's pictures and levels. Not affiliated with Madbox.

games.name: Subway Surfers
games.description: Run the tracks, dodge trains, grab coins.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's models and icons. Not affiliated with SYBO or Kiloo.

games.name: Temple Run
games.description: Run from the demon monkeys: turn, jump, slide.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's models and pictures. Not affiliated with Imangi Studios.

games.name: Tetris
games.description: Falling blocks: complete lines, don't top out.
games.credit: Tatone26's version (public domain), adapted for NumPlay. Not affiliated with The Tetris Company.

games.name: Tomb of the Mask
games.description: Dash through the tomb's mazes before the rising flood.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's stages and pictures. Not affiliated with Playgendary.

games.name: Undertale
games.description: Fall into the Underground, where nobody has to die.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's maps, pictures and texts. Not affiliated with Toby Fox.

games.name: Universal Paperclips
games.description: Make paperclips. Then make more. The whole incremental game.
games.credit: Fan game with the original's rules and texts. Not affiliated with Frank Lantz or Everybody House Games.
